title: Tidepool Astronautics
description: Space Ghost stands ankle-deep in a black tidal basin beneath a low, hazy moon, his white suit reflecting faint apricot and lilac highlights. Around him, tide pools contain tiny rotating galaxies, coral antennae, and glassy orbital rings instead of stars. A stranded brass weather buoy leans in the foreground, trailing delicate luminous seaweed toward the horizon. The composition is wide and calm, with the strongest detail concentrated in the lower two-thirds and an uncluttered dark sky across the top.
prompt:
Create exactly one beautiful 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600. It is an affectionate, funny Space Ghost parody in a painterly style with extraordinary detail, rich atmospheric depth, luminous highlights and beautiful canvas texture. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular, white costume, black hood/mask, yellow cape, red power bands. Make the visual joke readable and charming without explanatory text. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colors that suit the scene naturally. No UI, words, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Theme: Tidepool Astronautics. Landscape editorial wallpaper painted in gouache, risograph grain, and softly weathered mineral textures; an uncanny coastal-science mood where moonlit tide pools behave like miniature observatories. Use layered matte shapes, delicate ink contours, translucent brine stains, subtle paper fibers, and restrained asymmetry. The palette feels nocturnal but unfamiliar: deep kelp-black, oxidized lilac, mineral apricot, cold sea-glass teal, and small glints of tarnished silver. Keep the upper edge quiet and spacious, with no lettering or typography.
